residual_assessment.precise_problem: How should UCT treat a reflex/endorsement twin when equality may refer to a selected projection, history-expanded organization or declared complete actual organization?
residual_assessment.net_increment_after_subtraction: A UCT-specific signature-ladder repair, complete-twin stopping rule, target-identification obstruction and explicit use/test direction discipline; no claim of new isomorphism or factorization mathematics.
closest_internal_predecessors: R157 selector transport and semantic residual
residual_assessment.reusable_knowledge: A projected twin refutes only projection-factorized bridges; a complete twin cannot be internally discriminated and, under C1, cannot differ in complete experiential type. Structural difference and phenomenal naming remain separate obligations.
residual_assessment.evidence_and_limits: 65,536-predicate/256-projection exact enumeration, 16,384 compatible sparse-label bridges, primary-source comparison and full structural-map audit; no actual installation, B_fam, reviewer closure or worldwide priority.
residual_assessment.next_specific_action: Predeclare a nonreport contrast class for B_fam and determine whether independent target constraints reduce the bridge set without selecting the target from the same outcomes.
